physics_domain.description: Plain-language label for the physics or substrate domain (e.g. 'Newtonian mechanics', 'Maxwell electrodynamics', 'Standard Model', 'BBN nucleosynthesis', 'cryptography/RSA').

class_cascade.description: A-N cascade composition encoding the domain's axiomatic content (e.g. 'A-compose-M-compose-I-compose-C-compose-K-compose-L').

classes_used.description: Distinct A-N classes appearing in the cascade composition.

n_classes_used.description: Count of distinct classes in classes_used; tests the minimal-cascade hypothesis.

hurwitz_partition_signature.description: Bitmask over the candidate Hurwitz partition 1+3+7+3=14: 'A0_IC3_DEFGKLM7_BHN3' indicates which sub-group each used class lives in. Per [[project_a_n_operators_are_harmonic_objects_themselves]].

uses_cascade_detection_heptad.description: Uses any of {D, E, F, G, K, L, M}

coverage_status.description: How well-established the cascade-decomposition is per existing framework spikes.

framework_anchor.description: Link to MFO §, srmech §, Spike # that establishes the cascade-decomposition (e.g. 'Spike #58 / MFO §VII.4.1', 'Kolmogorov 1933', 'srmech.qm.single_particle').

open_fermata.description: Brief note on outstanding sub-questions (empty string if none).
